reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes FMDiff for diffusion-based image compression, with Fourier/Mamba branches for local/global image-frequency dependencies. Ablations compare magnitude/phase and Mamba variants; conclusion reports image distortion/perceptual tradeoffs. It addresses image compression and reconstruction, not LLM inference or KV/serving efficiency.
title: Learning Heterogeneous Global Local Frequency Dependencies in Diffusion-Based Image Compression
